events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect day titles source, stray hours, and push state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; cat app/src/lib/day-titles.ts | head -60; echo ---; git grep -n "4 to 6 h" -- app/src workshop-plan/playbook.html cloud/src | head; echo ---; git fetch -q origin; git log --oneline origin/main -1; git log --oneline origin/main..main | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find stray hours and unpushed commits
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git grep -n "4 to 6 h" -- app/src workshop-plan/playbook.html cloud/src | cut -c1-220 | head; echo ---; git log --oneline origin/main -1; git log --oneline origin/main..main | head -5; git grep -n "5 to 6 h" -- workshop-plan/playbook.html | cut -c1-200 | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check push state, step context and Day 1 time sum
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git merge-base --is-ancestor 9ea3b9a0 origin/main && echo pushed; git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...main; sed -n 3240,3251p workshop-plan/playbook.html | grep -o 'id="[^"]*"\|<h[34][^<]*' | tail -3; sed -n 440,447p app/src/lib/onboarding-tasks.ts; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate which day the 4 to 6 h step belongs to
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; awk 'NR<=3251 && /id="d[0-9]/{l=NR": "substr($0,1,140)} END{print l}' workshop-plan/playbook.html; grep -n 'id="d3"' workshop-plan/playbook.html|head -2; sed -n 425,432p app/src/lib/onboarding-tasks.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find probe scripts and options
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; ls scripts | grep -E "probe-(details|onboarding-tabs|headings|anonymity)|check-guides"; grep -n "SKIP\|process.env\|argv" scripts/probe-details.mjs | head -20

events.text: Checking the T-191 fixes myself now. Next I'm running the probes against the mirror.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe-details args, run tsc and check-guides
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; sed -n 20,40p scripts/probe-details.mjs | cut -c1-200; (npx tsc --noEmit -p . >/tmp/t191v-tsc.log 2>&1; echo tsc=$?) ; (node scripts/check-guides.mjs >/tmp/t191v-cg.log 2>&1; echo cg=$?; tail -2 /tmp/t191v-cg.log)

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-details against the mirror, centre skipped
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; M=https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live; (timeout 500 node scripts/probe-details.mjs $M - >/tmp/t191v-pd.log 2>&1; echo pd=$?); grep -c "FAIL \[" /tmp/t191v-pd.log; grep "FAIL \[" /tmp/t191v-pd.log | cut -c1-220; grep -i "390\|playbook" /tmp/t191v-pd.log | grep -v "^  ok" | head -5; tail -3 /tmp/t191v-pd.log
